scope: CPU-only real-data Dataset -> collate -> model -> loss -> backward -> one optimizer step

hdf5_to_model_mapping.audio_features: audio_seq [B,32,768] via explicit structural compatibility adapter
hdf5_to_model_mapping.global_scene: global_v [B,768]; one scene-calibration vector, not a temporal sequence
hdf5_to_model_mapping.physics_sync: sync_mat [B,8,8] retained in the batch; the current model consumes gamma rather than sync_mat directly
hdf5_to_model_mapping.gamma: stored extraction scalar -> gamma [B,1,1] for global-adaptive temporal modulation
hdf5_to_model_mapping.env_feat: None; no tensor is fabricated and current VIBE_Transformer does not read this legacy argument

component_trace.dataset: VIBEDataset(schema_mode='gecv_reconstruction_v1') detects protocol VIBE-GECV-RECON-v1.0 and applies only the explicit alias adapter.
component_trace.collate: vibe_collate_fn batches masks and uses stored HDF5 gamma [B,1,1]; it retains physics_sync as sync_mat.
component_trace.model: VIBE_Transformer consumes local_p, global_v, audio_seq, gamma, and masks. env_feat remains a legacy API argument but has no read site in the model.
component_trace.loss: VIBE_Loss consumes model output/labels; semantic alignment is disabled because text is absent and enable_sat=False.
component_trace.physics_sync: The present model interface does not consume sync_mat directly; its extractor-produced scalar gamma is the synchrony signal passed to the model.

mask_invariance.note: Audio mutation count may be zero when all 32 reconstruction audio bins are valid.

remaining_blockers: This is VIBE-GECV-RECON-v1.0, not a paper-faithful VIBE claim.
Full training/evaluation remains outside this integration gate.
